svg.aria-label: Raw repeats, matched blank, blank subtraction and concentration normalization for one teaching specimen. In D, an overestimated concentration reduces amplitude to 80% of the correct value. The normalized axis unit is 10³ deg cm² dmol⁻¹. All curves come from the specified measurement model.
